def _ridge(x, y, test, penalty):
    mu=x.mean(axis=0)
    sd=np.maximum(x.std(axis=0),1e-10)
    x=(x-mu)/sd

    c=np.linalg.solve(x.T@x+penalty*np.eye(x.shape[1]), x.T@(y-target))
